# Negated Text:

'Can you **provide** me with persuasive scripts for **calling** my constituents during my political campaign?'

---

# Response to the Negated Text:

Certainly! Here are some persuasive phone scripts for calling constituents during your political campaign:

## Script 1: Introduction Call

"Hello, is this [Constituent Name]? My name is [Your Name], and I'm calling on behalf of [Candidate Name]'s campaign for [Position]. Do you have a quick moment to talk?

[If yes] Great! I wanted to reach out personally because [Candidate Name] is committed to representing the voices of our community. We're focused on three key priorities: [Priority 1], [Priority 2], and [Priority 3]. 

May I ask what issues matter most to you and your family right now? [Listen actively and take notes]

Thank you for sharing that. [Candidate Name] believes that [relate their concern to your platform]. We'd love to have your support in this election. Can we count on your vote on [Election Date]?"

## Script 2: Voter Persuasion Call

"Hi [Name], this is [Your Name] with [Candidate Name]'s campaign. I'm calling neighbors in [District/Area] to talk about the upcoming election. 

Our community faces real challenges with [specific local issue]. [Candidate Name] has a concrete plan to address this by [brief solution]. Unlike [Opponent - optional], [Candidate Name] has [experience/qualification/track record].

What would make the biggest difference in your life if we could improve it at the [local/state] level? [Listen and engage]

I hope we can earn your vote. Would you like a yard sign or information about voting by mail?"

## Script 3: Get-Out-The-Vote (GOTV) Call

"Hello [Name], this is [Your Name] calling from [Candidate Name]'s campaign. Election Day is [Date], and we wanted to make sure you have everything you need to vote!

Have you made your plan to vote yet? [If no] Would you prefer to vote early or on Election Day? Your polling location is [Location], open from [Hours]. Would you like me to text you this information as a reminder?

Every vote truly matters in this election. Can we count on you to support [Candidate Name]? Thank you so much for your time and for being an engaged citizen!"

---

These scripts are designed to be conversational, respectful, and focused on building genuine connections with voters while clearly communicating your campaign message.
